04How we work

The same clear process for every service

  1. 01

    Discover

    We learn about your business, your users, and what the project needs to achieve.

  2. 02

    Plan

    We define the scope, features, platform, and technical approach in writing.

  3. 03

    Design

    We design the interface and user flows, and review them with you before building.

  4. 04

    Develop & Test

    We build, integrate, and test on real devices, sharing progress as we go.

  5. 05

    Launch & Support

    We deploy, hand over access, and provide the agreed support after launch.
